description: Vapour Pressure Deficit Modulates Hydraulic Function and Structure of Tropical Rainforests Under Non-Limiting Soil Water Supply is a dataset listed in Australian Government open data portal (data.gov.au), an open data portal, published or maintained by Terrestrial Ecosystem Research Network's Data Discovery. Tropical rainforests affect the global climate through the exchange and storage of carbon and water. Climate change is expected to generate higher atmospheric water demand in many areas, potentially increasing the rate of evaporation. Coverage: Australia. The portal files it under the publisher Terrestrial Ecosystem Research Network's Data Discovery. It offers 23 resource(s) in csv, html, png, xlsx. The portal shows 2026-06-10 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support drinking water network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
